title: Relating to workers' compensation; to amend Section 25-5-11, Code of Alabama 1975, to further provide for the employer's right of subrogation against uninsured and underinsured motorist insurance; and to specify that in a settlement of claims against a third party, the employer's share of the employee's attorney fees does not include costs or expenses.
